newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK manufacturing employment falls 15.2 pct in Sept.
newsitem.headline: HK manufacturing employment falls 15.2 pct in Sept.

text.p: Employment in Hong Kong's manufacturing sector fell 15.2 percent in September 1996 from the same month a year earlier, the Census and Statistics Department said on Friday.
Employment in wholesale, retail, import and export trades, restaurants and hotels rose 1.5 percent during the same period, it said.
In the finance, insurance, real estate and business services sector, employment was up 4.2 percent, while construction sites saw a rise of 16.3 percent.
Employment in transport, storage and communications rose 5.8 percent. It rose 5.4 percent in community, social and personal services.
The number of vacancies on construction sites fell 42.6 percent, the department said.
